video_title: Carmelo Anthony & Nigel Sylvester Debate the Greatest Air Jordan Collabs Ever

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on his vision for the Jordan Brand .5 sneaker
quotes.excerpt: I wanted to be the .5 athlete because MJ had the ones, the twos, the threes, the fours, the fives.
quotes.quote: The .5 is a story within itself. In my eyes, there was only one. Michael Jordan was one. I wanted to be the .5 athlete because MJ had the ones, the twos, the threes, the fours, the fives. So now I was taking what MJ already had and built with his sneaker line and with Tinker and them built, and I am coming with this post-Jordan era, this new culture, this new Jordan brand looking ahead. I am not about to fuck the shit up. We are going to match these and we are going to do our own version because this is the new version of what is already there.

quotes.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
quotes.summary_phrase: Nigel Sylvester and Carmelo Anthony debate Jordan 4s vs Jordan 1s
quotes.excerpt: I am not a low-top guy, so I could never pull off those Travis Scott Jordan 1s.

text_blocks.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
text_blocks.text: Nigel Sylvester Jordan 4 brick by bricks versus the Travis Scott Jordan 1s. Hell of a matchup.

text_blocks.speaker: Nigel Sylvester
text_blocks.text: I am not a low-top guy, so I could never pull off those Travis Scott Jordan 1s.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: See, I am a low-top guy. I am a rojo guy. I am a rojo guy. So we are team rojo.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony recalls the Dior Jordan 1 collaboration launch in Mexico
quotes.excerpt: Dior came and presented the whole line. They did the wallets, they did the lows.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: They came to the Board of Governors. We were in Mexico somewhere, and Dior came and presented the whole line. They did the wallets, they did the lows. They did the lows with those and they did a bag, I think. The way that they presented that, I am going with those.

text_blocks.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
text_blocks.text: We got to break this tie. They both got crazy stories for both of these.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the cultural impact of his Jordan 4 collaboration
quotes.excerpt: He shifted the culture when it comes to athlete collaborations.
quotes.quote: For him to take an already staple of a signature, which is the four, the Jordan 4, and to bring his culture, which was biking and being Mexican and doing wheelies and some queens, and he brought that shit and really shifted the culture when it comes to athlete collaborations. It wasn't too many other collaborations, non-athlete collaborations. Like a Travis Scott is a non-athlete collaboration. A Drake is a non-athlete collaboration. He is an athlete with that collaboration, so he kicked the door in. Which is why them shits are selling like this. People are starting to understand your cultural relevance and see your vision.
